name: The Calcium Vault
developmental_beat: Mineral deposition: the body gains its first rigid structure.
plan_refs: DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md §4 (calcium / minerals as an Open future resource)

obstacles.role: hard pillar; no grip purchase on its face
overhang forming a low tunnel that requires grip

obstacles.fallback_until_implemented: Use a solid slab with the same bounds until contact damage is built.

upgrade.name: Contractile body — dash
upgrade.softlock_fallback: Dash is a traversal shortcut, never a gate; swim, crawl and grip cross every required route.
upgrade.fallback_until_implemented: Use the existing swim speed and grip movement until the dash is built.
upgrade.note: Calcium is flavour for this stage only; it is not implemented as a second meter.

boss.name: The Vine Lash
boss.loop: A rooted tendril sweeps a long horizontal arc, then recoils.
boss.softlock_fallback: The sweep is readable and can also be grip-dodged above or below; dash is an option, not a requirement.
boss.fallback_until_implemented: Use the Rot Bloom's lash phase until the sweeping tendril is built.
boss.solution: Dash through the recoil, or grip to the ceiling and burst during the same window.

future_resource.name: calcium
future_resource.note: Inspiration only; no structural resource meter is created by this map.

narrative.beat: Hardness appears for the first time; the world gains edges.
